title: Be authorised to wholesale medicines and poisons
what: Carry on a business of buying or selling scheduled substances by wholesale only under a wholesale chemist's licence, and of making or refining them for sale only under a manufacturing chemist's licence (both granted by the Minister under s 16).

sources.title: Poisons Act 1971 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person– (a) who– (i) carries on the business of making or refining a scheduled substance for sale while not the holder of a licence under paragraph (a) of subsection (1) of section 16 ; or (ii) carries on the business of buying or selling a scheduled substance in the course of a wholesale dealing while not the holder of a licence under paragraph (b) of that subsection

sources.title: Poisons Act 1971 (Tas)
sources.locator: s 16, words naming the body (found 20 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: The Minister, in his discretion, may, on the application of a person under subsection (1AA) , grant, or refuse to grant, to that person– (a) a licence to carry on business as a manufacturing chemist;

reach.condition: if it buys or sells scheduled substances by wholesale, or makes or refines them for sale
